title: Parameters and training compute
goal:
Section 2.1 defines the model size $N$ as the number of non-embedding parameters, $N \approx 2\, d_\text{model}\, n_\text{layer}\,(2\, d_\text{attn} + d_\text{ff})$ (Equation 2.1), and the training compute as $C \approx 6NBS$ (Section 1.3). Write four functions:

- `non_embedding_params(n_layer, d_model, d_attn=None, d_ff=None)`. `d_attn` defaults to `d_model` and `d_ff` defaults to `4 * d_model`.
- `embedding_params(n_vocab, n_ctx, d_model)`, the $(n_\text{vocab} + n_\text{ctx})\, d_\text{model}$ term of Table 1.
- `forward_flops_per_token(n_layer, d_model, n_ctx, d_attn=None, d_ff=None)`, Equation 2.2: $2N + 2\, n_\text{layer}\, n_\text{ctx}\, d_\text{attn}$.
- `training_compute_pf_days(n_params, batch_tokens, steps)`. One PF-day is $10^{15} \times 24 \times 3600$ operations; the starter defines `PF_DAY`.

The tests include shapes that don't have $d_\text{ff} = 4\, d_\text{model}$, because the standard-shape shortcut $12\, n_\text{layer}\, d_\text{model}^2$ hides that bug.
hints: Write the general formula first. For `d_attn = d_model` and `d_ff = 4 * d_model` it collapses to `12 * n_layer * d_model**2`, which is a good check.
Don't add embedding parameters to $N$. The paper excludes them on purpose (Section 3.2, Figure 6).
The `6` in $C = 6NBS$ is 2 for the forward pass plus about 4 for the backward pass (Section 2.1). `batch_tokens` already counts tokens, so don't multiply by the context length again.
